title: perideridia gairdneri
intro: Perideridia gairdneri, commonly known as Gairdner's yampah, is a perennial plant that belongs to the carrot family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Perideridia gairdneri are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and act as an expectorant. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
